changes.text: Home Sweet Home - Spend 60 seconds in your own Supergroup base.
Based - Visit a super group base to earn this badge.

A visit means you spend 60 seconds in a base from a Supergroup other than your own. You can enter bases via leader teammates, coalition permissions, base passcodes, or the public base listing in the Supergroup Registrar. Once you visit a base, it will not give you credit for a visit again until it resets.
Truly Based - Visit 10 super group bases to earn this badge.
Actually Based - Visit 50 super group bases to earn this badge.
Unfathomably Based - Visit 100 super group bases to earn this badge.

Surveyor of Mazes - Spend 100 hours offline in the Labyrinth of Fog to earn this badge. Logging out within the Labyrinth of Fog will earn you a bonus to the number of Nightmare Obols you receive, when you log back in, each time you complete a mission for a short time.
Dreamcatcher - Defeat 100 of the Labyrinthine Nightmare to earn this badge.
Ten Times The Victor - The nine badges leading up to this badge are now kept and with new badge art.
Updated the art of the villain "badge count" badges to be more in-line with their original look from Retail.

Lucid Dreamer - Badge is now hinted after obtaining Core access. Badge hint mentions the badge unlocks Origin access.
The various badges rewarded for completing the Shining Stars/Hearts of Darkness tutorial arcs now also awards to team members, instead of being owner-only.

When attempting to add an enhancement to a power with no empty slots, the game will try to reassign an empty slot from another power, if one is available. This allows for moving slots between powers without doing a full blown respec.

When clicked, they will display the Supergroup's name, motto and description.
Any base passcodes in the description that are surrounded with square brackets will be turned into links to enter that base.
Example: [CODE-1234]
New setting in the Supergroup Base Settings, under Base Entry Permission: "Public Access".
Bases that are set to Public will appear as clickable links in the Supergroup Registrar listing.
This listing is cached; when you change your public base status, it will take some time for the list to update.
You have to be within 20ft of the registrar NPC for the links to send you into a base; if you move away from it, the links won't work.

Supergroups that put their own base passcode in the Description field, which is visible by anyone, will automatically be made Public. This will only happen once, when the update is released. If you do not wish your base to become Public at that point, remove the Passcode from the description.
New commands: /sg_set_public and /enter_public_base
/sg_set_public requires Base Entry permission and it takes 1 or 0 as a parameter.
Using /sg_set_public 1 will make your base accessible by either using /enter_public_base with just the supergroup ID, or /enter_base_from_passcode using any passcode.
For example, if your SG ID is 1234, you would be able to use /enter_public_base 1234 or /enter_base_from_passcode ANYTHING-1234 -- any passcode will be taken as valid if the base is public.
Using /sg_set_public 0 will remove public access to the base; the passcode and other permissions will still work, if set.
Prestige is now the estimated number of unique visitors the base has received since this patch.
The estimate is based on a HyperLogLog with 256 buckets. Account IDs are not tracked.

Bouncer command inside SG bases: /kiosk bouncer home allows you to kick a character from the base, and prevent any of their alts from entering it. The list persists until the base resets. You can remove players from the block list from the same window.
